What it does once it lands: the posts row is ‹, 💬, +, ●, undo — tap ● to record, ■ to stop, and the recording appears as a post with a play pill; your two old notes will show up as older posts dated when you made them; 🎤 leaves the launcher. One thing to know before you update the phone: the migration of the old notes runs on boot (the `RecList` reseed), so they'll appear the first time the new build opens, once your profile card is there — which it is.
